thread.title: All but 1 Dow stock trading lower premarket

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: All but 1 Dow stock trading lower premarket
text:
Published: Aug 2, 2018 8:00 a.m. ET Share Tomi Kilgore Reporter and editor A previous version incorrectly reported in the headline how many Dow stocks were trading higher. It has been corrected
Of the 28 Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -0.07% components seeing premarket activity, DowDuPont Inc.'s stock DWDP, -2.31% is the only one trading higher. Dow futures YMU8, +0.05% sank 149 points. The agriculture, materials science and specialty products company's shares edged up 0.4% after the company beat second-quarter earnings and revenue expectations and provided an upbeat outlook. Among the biggest premarket Dow decliners, shares Cisco Systems Inc . CSCO, +1.48% shed 1%, of Caterpillar Inc. CAT, -0.61% gave up 0.9% and of Microsoft Corp. MSFT, +1.13% lost 0.9%. The most active Dow stock ahead of the open is Apple Inc .'s AAPL, +3.10% which fell 0.6% after closing at a record in the previous session. Shares of Travelers Companies Inc. TRV, -0.47% and United Technologies Corp. UTX, -0.53% were still inactive in premarket trade.
